youtube_metadata.title: Anthropic Launches Claude Sonnet 5.5: 70.6% Terminal-Bench Record #Shorts
youtube_metadata.description:
Anthropic has released Claude Sonnet 5.5. Engineered as the ultimate daily driver for developers, it features 1M context, 128k output tokens, +30% speed, and a record 70.6% score on Terminal-Bench 4.0.
